text:
Priya: Quick heads-up — ACME pilot asked for per-tenant routing controls (weighting, preferred-region, fallback). Competitor launched a similar product yesterday; sales flagged as risk. Need a decision: ship parity quickly or propose a different value prop? :eyes:
Sam: They'll churn unless we match something tangible. ACME is our biggest pilot. I'd push for a narrow parity MVP: per-tenant weight + region pin. Timeline ask = ~3 weeks.
Priya: Don't want to promise full competitor parity. Options: A) Parity MVP (weights + region pin), B) Differentiator: signal-driven routing (latency/cost-aware), C) Hybrid: parity now, signal routing in Q2. Eng estimates needed.
Alex: Parity MVP is doable but not trivial. Spike required for routing rule engine + tenant config store. Rough: 1wk spike + ~3-4wks dev+qa. Rollout safety (flags, migrations) adds effort.
Jordan: This touches Dedicated routing logic and our smart routing layer. We can implement feature-flagged rollout per-tenant, but we need schema migration plan and capacity gating.
Rina: Signal-driven routing needs telemetry first (per-tenant p50/p95/p99, model cost proxies). That’s a larger scope with an SLO tuning loop. Not for a fast ship.
Ella: I can mock admin UX in 48h if we go parity MVP. Keep controls minimal: weight slider, preferred region dropdown, fallback toggle.
Sam: ACME wants commitment. They gave us 2 weeks to show a plan or they escalate to competitor.
Alex: Realistic breakdown: spike (1w) -> MVP dev (3w) -> staged rollout (1-2w). If we cut region pin out of MVP we might shave a week.
Priya: Proposal: run spike this week, decide by Friday. If spike OK, ship parity-MVP limited to weights + fallback + hidden admin UI behind flag. Signal routing moved to Q2 backlog.
Rina: Agree. We should capture telemetry event list during spike: token_latency, model_cost_est, route_decision, fallback_trigger.
Jordan: I'll draft rollout/playbook and required rollback hooks during spike. Also will enumerate infra config changes.
Sam: Make sure ACME contract team has SLA impact notes and a clear opt-in for pilot. I'll handle comms.
Ella: I'll drop two quick screens and a compact config example in #design within 24h. Example config:
```json
{
  "tenant_id": "acme",
  "routing": {
    "weight": 0.8,
    "preferred_region": "us-west-2",
    "fallback_policy": "nearest_available"
  }
}
```
Priya: Owners: Alex = spike + dev lead, Jordan = rollout & infra, Ella = admin UX, Rina = telemetry & SLOs, Sam = ACME comms. I'll produce an MRD draft and share by EOD Friday.
deploy-bot: calendar invite created: "routing-spike-kickoff" Thu 09:00 — attendees: Alex, Jordan, Rina, Ella, Priya
Sam: :raised_hands: Thanks — this plan keeps us moving and gives ACME a clear runway.
Priya: Final note: keep scope razor-focused. If the spike shows surprising infra blockers, we fallback to delivering only weight controls and the admin UI as a toggleable beta.
